seasons.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for kharif crops
seasons.quote: For green manure crop, sow 20 kg seed per acre with drill in lines 20-22.5 cm apart from April to July.

days_to_first_harvest.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for kharif crops
days_to_first_harvest.quote: Bury 6 to 8 weeks old dhaincha/cowpea/sunnhemp one day before transplanting of paddy.
days_to_first_harvest.note: A green manure is dug in, not harvested: 6 weeks = 42 days.

water_need.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for kharif crops
water_need.quote: The crop sown for green manure during the summer period require 3-4 irrigations depending upon the prevailing weather conditions.
water_need.note: 3-4 irrigations in a 6-8 week crop: read as 'low'. Agronomist to confirm.

source_notes: AI research batch 11 (2026-10-07). Ranges are stored at their lower bound unless a note says otherwise; the source range is in each quote. Sowing months for Madhya Pradesh come from the state crop-season table (SLBC); other values are TNAU/PAU guides (Tamil Nadu, Punjab) until a local source is found.
